lines: +The training loop put every assistant turn through SGLang's tool-call parser alone, while the eval/deploy endpoint separates reasoning first; the loop therefore executed `<tool_call>` drafts written inside `<think>...</think>` (which the generation prompt itself opens for Qwen3.5/GLM, so the draft needs no opening tag in the output). The Qwen3-Coder detector also "repairs" a generation that ends inside `<tool_call>` (no `</tool_call>`), and the XML detectors guess argument types from the value instead of the schema — GLM re-dumped JSON-looking `file_text` (the 6 mutated data-agent calls), Qwen3-Coder turned a string `"null"` into `None` and left `anyOf` numbers (`execute_bash.timeout`) as strings. For models not yet run, SGLang's gpt-oss detector does not match the harmony form the model/template actually emit (`assistant to=functions.x<|channel|>commentary json...`, and a first call whose `<|start|>assistant` is already in the prompt), so it would have run no gpt-oss calls; Qwen2.5/Hermes and Llama detectors likewise missed whitespace variants of their formats.

+The fix adds [tool-call parsing](/app/agent_rl/examples/tool_agent/tool_call_parsing.py) used by [the rollout loop](/app/agent_rl/examples/tool_agent/agent_loop.py): reasoning is separated first (initial reasoning state taken from the actual context/generation prompt, harmony analysis channels for gpt-oss), only calls finished outside reasoning run (closing `</tool_call>` / complete JSON object / `<|call|>` required), and XML values are typed only by the tool schema with strings kept verbatim, while JSON-format values stay as written. The model's reasoning parser is now passed to the loop by [the launcher](/app/agent_rl/launch/run_tool_agent.py) (`--generate-reasoning-parser`, same table value as `--sglang-reasoning-parser`); entry point, samples, tokens, loss masks and rewards are otherwise unchanged, except that appending tool results no longer crashes on a multi-call turn under the single-call Llama template.

+Verified with the regression tests in [the test file](/app/agent_rl/tests/test_tool_call_parsing.py) (23 tests), full offline replays of all four recorded runs (no episode errors; the GLM data trial's 6 mutated arguments are now byte-exact), synthetic replay episodes for all seven launcher models on both agents, and a final live batch (run 1: 160 rollouts, 0 errors; SQL 128 rollouts/950 calls, data 32/315).
